## Security Gate (REQUIRED to defeat this boss)

- [ ] **STRIDE threat model** drawn for the feature(s) shipped this month (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Info disclosure, DoS, Elevation)
- [ ] Top 2 threats have a written mitigation (or accepted-risk note)
- [ ] **OWASP Top-10 pass** — checked auth, injection, access control, secrets, logging
- [ ] Healthcare data touched? PHI access is authorized + audit-logged
- [ ] Threat model saved as `docs/threat-models/W__.md` and linked from the write-up

> The boss is NOT defeated until this gate is green. Tick the `TM` box in the tracker app.
